sentences: Check the fuse before replacing the whole unit.

I soldered the broken wire on the workbench.
The receiver passed the bench test.

grammar.title: Causa e consequência na bancada: because / because of / so
rules: Use because + frase completa (sujeito + verbo): "The monitor turned off because the cable was loose."
Use because of + substantivo: "The fuse burned because of a short circuit." / "because of moisture."
Use so para mostrar o resultado (então / por isso): "The pin was bent, so we replaced the connector."
Voz passiva curta para dano: "was damaged by water" / "was damaged by rodents".

rows: It failed because the wire broke.
It was loose, so I tightened it.
